outputs.explanation: The lower bar graph shows mean ± SD of HMGB1 signal intensity (Nuc/Cyto) across genotypes without overlaid individual data points, despite large sample sizes (N=4, n>100).
The bar graph of % aggregate-positive Purkinje cells shows mean ± SD only (N=4, n>400) without individual data points overlaid.
Panel C is a western blot image, not a plot of averaged data.
Panel D is a line plot (rotarod performance over weeks); line plots are exempt from the individual-data-points requirement.
Panel E consists of line plots (rotarod performance across days); line plots are exempt from the individual-data-points requirement.
Panel F is a Kaplan-Meier survival curve, a line plot type exempt from the individual-data-points requirement.
Panel G shows micrograph images of histological staining, not a quantitative plot of averages.
Both bar graphs (molecular layer thickness and Purkinje cell number) show mean ± SD only (N=3, n=9) without individual data points overlaid.
